MyFundedClub - Membership Perks and Rewards
August 28, 2026
What is MyFundedClub?

MyFundedClub is the official loyalty program of MyFundedFutures, designed to reward traders for their engagement and achievements. Members can earn points by referring friends, participating in the community, and reaching key milestones throughout their trading journey. 

 

These points can then be redeemed for valuable rewards, including evaluation discounts, exclusive merchandise, and card packs, making every step of the experience more rewarding.

 

 

Is There a Cost to Join?

 

Not at all. MyFundedClub is completely free to join, and there is no cost to participate or earn points.
​

 

Who Can Join MyFundedClub?

MyFundedClub is open to eligible traders who meet a few simple requirements. To participate, you must:

Be at least 18 years of age.

Register as an individual trader.

Accept the MyFundedClub Terms and Conditions during the enrollment process.

Please note that membership is not available to:

Companies

Trading groups

Signal-selling businesses or operations

Important: Reward packs and points are only issued after the Terms and Conditions have been reviewed and accepted.

 

 

In addition, participants must reside in a location where MyFundedFutures and the loyalty program are legally permitted to operate and may not be employees, contractors, or immediate family members of MyFundedFutures team members.

 

To ensure a fair and rewarding experience for everyone, each person is limited to one membership account. Duplicate memberships may be voided, and MyFundedFutures reserves the right to apply reasonable limits based on factors such as email address, household, payment method, or device. 

 

These measures help protect the integrity of the program and ensure rewards are distributed fairly among members.

 

 

Earning Points

 

How do I Earn Points? 

MyFundedClub rewards members for a variety of activities that support their trading journey and engagement with the community. Points can be earned by completing qualifying actions, including:

Referrals – Share your unique referral link and earn points when a new trader signs up through your link and completes a qualifying purchase within 30 days.

Community Participation – Get involved with the MyFundedFutures community by joining and following official channels, such as Discord and other supported platforms.

 

Trading Milestones – Earn points for reaching specific achievements throughout your trading journey, such as completing qualifying trading days, maintaining compliance with account risk parameters, or successfully progressing through an evaluation stage. Points are awarded for predefined milestones only and are never based on trade size, trading frequency, profitability, or risk-taking behavior. Participation in the loyalty program does not alter your account's trading rules or requirements.

 

Re-Engagement Activities – If an account closes, you can continue earning points by getting back into the action through qualifying activities, such as purchasing a reset or starting a new evaluation.

 

For the latest list of eligible point-earning activities and their current point values, visit www.myfundedfutures.com/loyalty. As MyFunded Club evolves, available activities and point values may be updated to provide members with new ways to earn and engage.

 

 

How Do Referrals Work?

 

As a MyFunded Club member, you can earn points by referring friends to MyFundedFutures. You'll receive a unique referral link that you can share with others. Rewards depend on whether the person you refer is new to MFFU or already a customer. Referral points are awarded when a new MyFundedFutures customer enrolls through your link and completes a qualifying purchase within 30 days of signing up.
​

Referring a new customer

If you refer a friend who is new to MyFundedFutures, once they complete any purchase:

You receive 2,000 points

Your friend receives 500 points

 

Do we need to complete KYC to earn referral points?

 

No. KYC verification is not required at any point to earn or receive Refer a Friend points.

 

To keep the referral program fair and rewarding for everyone, please follow these important guidelines:

Share Responsibly – Only send your referral link to individuals who have agreed to receive it. Unsolicited or spam-like promotion is not permitted.

No Self-Referrals – Referrals involving accounts controlled by the same individual or household are not eligible for rewards and may be voided.

Qualifying Purchases Must Remain Valid – If a referred purchase is later refunded, cancelled, or subject to a chargeback, any associated referral points will be removed from your account.

Represent MyFundedFutures Accurately – When discussing MyFundedFutures, always be truthful and transparent. Do not guarantee profits, funded account approvals, trading success, or specific tax outcomes. Misleading claims can result in the loss of referral points and may lead to suspension from the program.

Referral Reward Limits May Apply – To maintain program integrity, MyFundedFutures may place reasonable limits on the number of referral rewards that can be earned during a specific period.

By following these guidelines, you can confidently share MyFundedFutures with others while earning points and helping the community grow.

 

 

Where Can I See My Points Balance?

You can view your current MyFundedClub points balance at any time through your MyFundedFutures account dashboard. Simply navigate to the MyFunded Club section to see your available points, track your activity, and monitor your progress toward rewards.

 

Do My Points Expire?

Not as long as you remain active in the program. Your points will only expire after 24 consecutive months without any point-earning activity or reward redemptions. Any qualifying activity or redemption resets this inactivity period, helping you keep your balance active.

 

To ensure you have ample time to use your points, MyFundedFutures will provide notice by email and through your dashboard at least 60 days before any points are scheduled to expire.

 

Can Points Ever Be Removed from My Balance?

In limited circumstances, points may be adjusted or removed to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the program. This may occur when:

A purchase associated with the points is refunded, cancelled, or charged back.

Points were credited in error.

A qualifying community action is later reversed, such as immediately unfollowing a channel after receiving points.

Points were earned through fraudulent activity, automation, abuse, or other forms of manipulation.

If points are removed after rewards have already been redeemed, your account may show a negative points balance. In that situation, any future points you earn will first be applied toward restoring your balance before additional points become available for redemption.

 

 

Redeeming Points

 

What Can I Redeem My Points For?

As you earn points through MyFundedClub, you can redeem them for a variety of rewards designed to enhance your MyFundedFutures experience. 

 

Current reward categories include:

Evaluation Discounts – Use points to save on new evaluations, resets, and other eligible MyFundedFutures products.

Official Merchandise – Redeem points for exclusive MyFundedFutures apparel and gear, available while supplies last.

BOGO Offers – From time to time, members may have the opportunity to redeem points for special buy-one-get-one evaluation promotions.

Card Packs – Unlock mystery-style reward packs that contain guaranteed prizes and benefits. Details on how Card Packs work can be found below.

The most current reward catalog, including available items and point costs, can always be found at www.myfundedfutures.com/loyalty.

 

 

How Do Card Packs Work?

Card Packs offer a fun and rewarding way to redeem your points while still providing transparency about what you'll receive.

Before redeeming, each Card Pack clearly displays:

The required point cost.

The guaranteed reward categories included in the pack.

Any applicable ranges or outcomes for randomized rewards.

For example, a Card Pack may guarantee:

One discount reward

One free account reward

One bonus prize

While the categories are guaranteed, the specific reward or tier within each category remains a surprise until the pack is opened.

 

Most importantly, every Card Pack delivers all advertised reward categories. There are no empty packs or losing outcomes.

 

Please note:

Card Pack rewards are single-use.

Rewards are non-transferable.

Unless otherwise stated, rewards expire 30 days after issuance.

Be sure to redeem and use your rewards before they expire.

 

 

Can I Combine a Reward Discount With a Promo Code?

Generally, no. Reward-based discounts cannot be combined with promotional codes or other offers unless the specific promotion explicitly states that stacking is permitted.

 

In addition, reward discounts:

Apply only to the eligible evaluation or reset purchase price.

Do not apply to other fees or charges.

Are typically single-use unless otherwise specified.

 

 

Are There Limits on Redemptions?

Certain rewards may be subject to redemption limits within a given period to ensure fair access for all members.

 

Examples may include:

A maximum number of merchandise redemptions per month.

A limit on evaluation discount redemptions during a calendar month.

Special limits tied to promotional rewards or limited-time offers.

Any active redemption limits will be displayed at www.myfundedfutures.com/loyalty.

 

 

What Should I Know About Merchandise Redemptions?

MyFundedFutures merchandise is offered on a first-come, first-served basis and is available only while inventory lasts.

 

When redeeming merchandise:

You'll provide shipping information through our designated fulfillment partner.

Shipping charges, customs duties, taxes, or other import fees are your responsibility unless otherwise stated.

Shipping details must be confirmed within 30 days of redemption.

Failure to complete the shipping process within the required timeframe may result in forfeiture of the reward.

Due to the nature of reward redemptions, merchandise orders are generally considered final, except in cases involving verified product defects.

 

 

Do Discounted Evaluations or Resets Have Different Rules?

No. Using a MyFunded Club reward does not change the terms, requirements, or functionality of your account.

 

Any evaluation or reset purchased using a points-based discount operates exactly the same as a standard purchase, including:

The same risk parameters

The same profit targets

The same trading rules

The same payout eligibility requirements

Rewards simply provide additional value to members. They do not alter the trading experience or create special account conditions.

 

 

Points, Your Account & the Rules

 

Do Points Have Cash Value?

No. MyFunded Club points are a loyalty reward and do not have any cash value. Points cannot be redeemed for cash or cryptocurrency and may not be sold, gifted, assigned, or transferred to another person, account, or membership. 

 

Points are intended solely for use within the MyFunded Club rewards program.

 

 

Does MyFundedClub Change Any of My Trading Rules?

No. MyFunded Club operates independently from your trading accounts and does not affect any aspect of your evaluation, funded, or live trading experience.

 

Earning or redeeming points will not impact:

Drawdown limits

Profit targets

Payout eligibility

Risk parameters

Trading permissions

Any other account rules

All trading account terms continue to be governed exclusively by your applicable Trader Agreement and program rules.

 

 

What Happens to My Points if I Breach an Account or Fail an Evaluation?

In most cases, nothing happens to your points. Your MyFunded Club membership and points balance are tied to you as a member, not to any individual trading account. A failed evaluation or account breach does not affect the points you've already earned.

 

In fact, members may have opportunities to earn additional points by re-engaging with the platform through qualifying activities, such as purchasing a reset or starting a new evaluation.

 

There is one important exception:

If your account is suspended, banned, or terminated due to a violation of MyFundedFutures' Terms of Service or MyFunded Club program rules, any unredeemed points may be forfeited.

 

 

Is There a Limit to the Rewards I Can Receive?

Yes. To ensure the program remains sustainable and fair for all participants, the total combined value of rewards and promotional benefits received from MyFundedFutures is subject to an annual limit.

 

This includes:

MyFunded Club points and rewards

Discounts

Promotional offers

Contest prizes

Other eligible MyFundedFutures incentives

The maximum combined value a member may receive is $2,000 USD during any rolling 12-month period. If additional rewards would cause a member to exceed this limit, MyFundedFutures may reduce, withhold, or defer those benefits until they become eligible under a future period.

 

 

Can I Leave the Program?

Absolutely. Participation in MyFundedClub is entirely voluntary, and you may opt out at any time by contacting support@myfundedfutures.com.

 

Before leaving the program, please note the following:

Any unredeemed points will be forfeited upon cancellation.

Forfeited points cannot be restored.

If you choose to rejoin the program in the future, previously forfeited points will not be reinstated.

For that reason, members may wish to redeem any available rewards before requesting to leave the program.

 

 

 

Changes, Support & Important Program Details
Can MyFundedClub Change Over Time?

Yes. As MyFundedClub continues to evolve, MyFundedFutures may periodically update eligible earning activities, point values, available rewards, redemption options, or other program features to enhance the member experience.

 

Any changes are applied prospectively, meaning they affect future participation and do not retroactively reduce the value of points that have already been earned. In general:

Points already in your balance will not be reduced due to program updates.

Previously earned points will not have their redemption value retroactively diminished.

Changes to earning opportunities and reward offerings will apply going forward.

The only exceptions may involve situations involving fraud, abuse, misuse of the program, or a complete discontinuation of MyFunded Club.

 

If the program is ever discontinued, members will receive at least 30 days' advance notice and will have that entire notice period to redeem any remaining eligible points before the program ends.

 

 

Need Help? We're Here for You.

If you have questions about your membership, points balance, earning activities, or reward redemptions, the MyFundedFutures support team is ready to assist.

You can contact support through:

Live Chat: help.myfundedfutures.com

Email: support@myfundedfutures.com

To help us resolve your request as quickly as possible, please include:

The email address associated with your MyFundedFutures account

Details about the activity, points transaction, or redemption in question

Any relevant order or account information, if applicable

Our team will review the issue and work with you to ensure your MyFunded Club experience remains smooth and rewarding.

What is MyFunded Futures policy around trading on key news releases?

August 31, 2026

Prohibited News Trading Activities
​

Engage in your trading activities mindfully, especially during news releases. The following activities are strictly prohibited:

Utilizing strategies that exploit immediate news bursts, such as straddles or strangles.

Masking news trades as standard strategies.

These prohibitions are in effect for all news releases.

 

 

Standard Trading Protocols
​

Maintain the integrity of your trading by:

Sticking to your regular trading system during news intervals.

Initiating trades based on standard entry rules.

Ensuring no open positions or orders are active in the order book 2 minutes before and after any data release.

These protocols apply to all news releases.

Looking to get Funded? Start here.

 

 ​

Tier 1 Data: Special Considerations
​

Ensure utmost caution by adhering to the following during Tier 1 Data Releases:

No positions or orders (including limit orders) can be open 2 minutes before and after the release.

At MyFundedFutures, we believe in providing traders with a clear path to success. A significant part of this journey involves understanding the evaluation parameters that guide your trading experience. These parameters are not just arbitrary rules; they are designed based on years of market experience and are aimed at fostering disciplined and profitable trading habits.
​

 

Explanation of Parameters

Before delving into strategies and trades, it’s crucial to understand the parameters that will be used to assess your performance.

Profit Target: 

This is the predetermined profit amount you aim to achieve within the evaluation period. It serves as a benchmark for your trading success.

Maximum Drawdown: 

This is the maximum allowable loss from the peak of your account balance. It's a safety net, ensuring that traders don't risk too much capital.

Daily Loss Limit: 

This parameter sets a cap on how much you can lose in a single trading day. It's designed to prevent spiraling losses on particularly volatile days.

EOD (End of Day) Drawdown: 

This refers to the drawdown that is pegged to your positive account performance and is adjusted at the end of the trading day. If you increase your profit by $1.00, then your minimum account balance will also rise by $1.00. This mechanism ensures that traders are rewarded for positive performance by providing them with a cushion against potential future losses.

Intraday Drawdown (Rapid Plans): 

A trailing drawdown is a dynamic loss limit that increases as your account's equity reaches new highs, but does not decrease when losses occur. MyFundedFutures uses intraday drawdown to monitor a trader's risk exposure throughout the trading day. 

Consistency Rule: 

This rule ensures that traders don't swing wildly in their trading sizes or strategies. It promotes steady and consistent trading habits.

Minimum Trading Days: 

Rapid and Pro evaluations require traders to trade for a minimum number of 2 days to ensure they are genuinely engaged and not just taking wild risks hoping for a lucky break.​

Importance and Impact on Trading

Understanding these parameters is not just about compliance; it's about internalizing the principles of disciplined trading:

Risk Management: 

The Maximum Drawdown, Intraday and EOD Drawdown parameters are quintessential for instilling robust risk management habits. They ensure that traders don't get carried away by emotions and make impulsive decisions that can jeopardize their accounts.

Goal Orientation: 

The Profit Target parameter gives traders a clear goal to strive for. It encourages forward planning and strategic thinking.

Consistency: 

The Consistency Rule in our evaluation plans ensures that traders develop a steady trading rhythm, which is crucial for long-term success in the markets.
​

 

Managing Your Trading Accordingly

With a clear understanding of these parameters, here's how you can tailor your trading:

Plan Your Trades: Always have a clear entry and exit strategy. Know your stop-loss and take-profit levels before entering a trade.

Monitor Your Performance: Regularly check your performance against the evaluation parameters. 

Stay Informed: Keep abreast of market news and events. External factors can significantly impact the markets, and being informed will help you make better trading decisions.

Seek Feedback: Don't hesitate to reach out to the MFFU community or support team for feedback or clarifications on your trading or the evaluation parameters.

Microscalping Rule

 

Q. Is Microscalping allowed on my live account?

A: Yes, microscalping is permitted on the live accounts. The CME does not impose any restrictions on this trading style, so we have no problem with this strategy.

 

What is Microscalping?

Microscalping is a popular strategy used by many traders to capture small price movements, usually a few ticks. Traders compound small, consistent profits with minimum market exposure.

 

However, this strategy relies on minimal slippage, instant execution, and ideal market conditions, but this may not always be attainable in live trading.

 

We allow microscalping to all our live traders; however, please be aware that this approach carries significant risks.

This trade lasted only 5 seconds. While quick profits can be tempting, any sudden market driver events during that time could result in damaging slippage and heightened risk.

 

Dollar-Cost Averaging Trading Strategy (DCA)

 

Q. Do you allow DCA on the live account?

A: Yes, DCA is allowed on live accounts, but be careful, as it is a risky trading strategy.

 

The DCA is one of the most used risk management strategies by traders, especially during market volatility. Instead of taking the whole position at once, they stage trades over a specified period. The method helps to reduce the emotional impact of market volatility.

 

Adding to a losing position without a proper plan or strategy is heavily discouraged, as it may lead to liquidation.

 

Example of DCA:

 

Here is a scenario to illustrate this strategy:

 

A live trader is going long on the NASDAQ (NQ). They first enter with 1contract, and as the price retraces, they scale in another contract. The price dips even further, then they scale in another contract, for a total of three contracts.

 

Another live trader is going short on ES. Price moves aggressively up past their original position, but they add another contract to their short. The trader is in a major loss in the hopes of a reversal.

A. No, once you request your profits to be withdrawn from your account, your available contracts will be set to 0 until the payout is approved and paid. This ensures traders do not lose the profits requested before the payout is processed, which can cause the payout request to be rejected.

Prohibited Trading Practices

The simulated market, while a robust and close approximation of live trading conditions, isn’t without its disparities. Understanding the Simulated Market Challenges

 

Certain trading strategies may exploit the simulated fill algorithm, performing well in the evaluation stage but inevitably resulting in losses when transitioned to live markets. A small subset of traders, either inadvertently or with the intent to manipulate the system, engage in these strategies, which are strictly prohibited at MFFU.

 

​

Section 1: Automated Trading Protocols

High-frequency Trading is not allowed on our plans.

Traders may make use of automated trading strategies tailored to their own specific settings so long as these automated tools do not aim to exploit the favorable fills offered in the Simulated Environment.

Section 2: Order Management and Market Conduct
​

MFFU emphasizes ethical trading practices and order management to ensure a stable and reliable trading environment:

 

●     Order Placement: Simultaneously placing multiple limit orders at the same price to manipulate order fills is prohibited.

●     Gapped or Illiquid Market Trading: Profiting from isolated, stale or unrealistic fills in low-liquidity contracts (including back-month contracts) or during low-volume hours is not allowed, regardless of how long the position is held.

●     Slippage and Bracket Usage: Exploiting the absence of slippage and utilizing tight brackets to gain from favorable fills are not permitted.

●     Tier 1 Economic Data Trading: Engaging in trades during tier 1 economic data releases is restricted.

●     Compliance with CME Group Rules: All trading activities must adhere to CME Group's rules and regulations.

●     Collaborative Trading: Collaborating with others to execute identical or opposite strategies across unconnected accounts is prohibited.

Section 3: Termination Policies and Violation Consequences

Account Rules
How the EOD Trailing Drawdown Works

The Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) is an End of Day (EOD) trailing drawdown. It does not move intraday. It only adjusts after the market closes each session, based on where your account closed.

The MLL trails upward as your account equity reaches new end-of-day highs.

It never moves down.

Open equity losses are counted when determining whether your account has breached the rule at the end of the trading day.

The MLL locks permanently once it reaches $100 above the starting balance. From that point, it does not trail further.

 

Example ($2,000 option): You start at $50,000 with a minimum balance of $48,000. If your account closes at $51,000, your new minimum balance allowed moves to $49,000. The $2,000 distance is always maintained while the drawdown is still trailing.

Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the difference between the two options?

The only structural difference is the Maximum Loss Limit: $1,500 or $2,000. A smaller MLL means a tighter safety cushion, with your account floor starting closer to your balance. In exchange, the Builder plan with Add-On is priced lower. Everything else, including profit target, payout rules, live parameters, and contract limits, is identical.

 

Q: Are there any activation fees?

Q: Is there a Daily Loss Limit (DLL)?

Yes. The Evaluation, Sim Funded and Live stage have a $1,000 soft pause DLL.

Q: Is there a consistency rule during evaluation?

No. The Builder Plan has no consistency rule during evaluation. You can pass in as little as 1 trading day, as long as you have hit the $3,000 profit target without breaching the MLL.

 

Q: How does the 50% consistency rule work on payouts?

Your single largest profit day in a payout cycle cannot account for more than 50% of your total profits in that cycle. This is calculated at the time of your payout request, and the calculation resets fully after each approved payout.

 

Example: If your total net profits since the last payout are $1,000, your best single day cannot exceed $500. If it does, you will need to trade additional days to bring that ratio into compliance before requesting.

 

Q: How much net profit do I need before my first payout?

You need at least $500 in net profit above the buffer. For example, on the $2,000 option, your account balance must reach at least $2,600 before you can submit your first payout request ($2,100 buffer plus $500 net profit above it).

 

Q: Can I have more than one active Sim Funded account?

No. Only one Sim Funded account may be active per user at any time on the Builder Plan. If your active Sim Funded account closes, a new one may be activated only after the following trading day.

 

Q: Can I trade news on the Builder Plan?

News trading is fully unrestricted on the Builder Plan.

 

Q: What happens if my live account is breached?

A live account breach triggers a 21-day cooldown period. During the cooldown, all sim funded account trading is prohibited and no new evaluations or account resets may be purchased. Once the 21 days have elapsed, all restrictions are lifted.

 

Q: Can I hold positions overnight?

No. All positions must be closed before the end of the trading session. Any open positions at session close will be automatically closed by the platform.

 

Q: What is the inactivity rule on the sim funded account?

If you do not place a trade within 7 consecutive calendar days on your sim funded account, the account will be closed due to inactivity. There is no inactivity rule on the live account.

2% Price Limit Rule

At MyFunded Futures, we prioritize protecting our traders from high volatility and hazardous market conditions. To achieve this, we enforce strict guidelines to prevent trading when a product is within 2% of a CME price limit. This policy ensures our traders are not exposed to extreme market fluctuations that could lead to significant losses.

 

A price limit is the maximum price range permitted for a futures contract in each trading session. When markets hit the price limit, different actions occur depending on the product being traded. Markets may temporarily halt until price limits can be expanded, remain in a limit condition, or stop trading for the day based on regulatory rules.

 

This prohibited conduct is enforced in the following accounts: Sim Funded Account and Live Funded Account.

 

 

How do I know what the CME Price Limits are for the contracts I trade?

Price limits are calculated based on the end-of-day settlement price and vary by product, contract month, and time of day (i.e., overnight price limits differ from the price limits used during business hours).

 

The price limits are updated at 5:05 PM EST after each trading session and can be found on the CME Price Limits page.

 

 

How Do I Ensure I Don't Trade Within 2% of a Price Limit?

Equity Products ES, MES, NQ, MNQ, RTY, M2K, YM, and MYM overnight price limits have increased to 5%, which is 2% below the CME limit of 7%. Consequently, trading is suspended at MyFunded Futures. 

 

One of the most effective ways to ensure you are not trading within 2% of any price limit is to monitor the % Net Change for the contract you are participating in via your trading platform's quote board.

Your trading platform’s quote board/radar screen not only displays the “Net Change” on the day as prices move but can also display “Net Change” as a percentage or “% Net Change.” If the “% Net Change” is not currently displayed on your quote board, simply add that column to display how close your product is to the price limit.

Trailing (Intraday) Drawdown

 

Definition

 

A Trailing Drawdown is a dynamic loss limit that increases as your account's equity reaches new highs, but does not decrease when losses occur. My Funded Futures uses intraday drawdown to monitor a trader's risk exposure throughout the trading day.

 

How It Works

 

At the funded stage, the trailing drawdown is calculated intraday based on your peak balance, which includes both realized and unrealized gains. The drawdown will adjust with your account as you experience gains, but it will not exceed the starting balance.

 

At the start of your evaluation or funded account, My Funded Futures sets the following:

 

Starting Balance: For example, $50,000

Maximum Trailing Drawdown Amount: For example, $2,000

 

Your initial equity limit is calculated as follows:

Starting Balance − Trailing Drawdown

→ $50,000 − $2,000 = $48,000

 

When your account reaches a new equity high, including unrealized profits, the trailing threshold adjusts upward accordingly:

 

New Equity High: $51,000

New Drawdown Limit: $51,000 − $2,000 = $49,000

 

If your account value declines, even during an open trade, the drawdown limit remains unchanged. However, if your equity, including open trades, falls below the most recently adjusted drawdown limit, your account will breach the maximum loss limit.

 

Traders can monitor the remaining intraday maximum drawdown limit while executing trades on their trading platforms.

 

For Tradovate accounts, keep track of your trailing drawdown doing the following:

Sign in to your Tradovate account.

Click in + sign in top right hand corner.

Account Rules

 

How the EOD Trailing Drawdown Works

The Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) is an End of Day (EOD) trailing drawdown. It does not move intraday. It only adjusts after the market closes each session, based on where your account closed.

The MLL trails upward as your account equity reaches new end-of-day highs.

It never moves down.

Open equity losses are counted when determining whether your account has breached the rule at the end of the trading day.

The MLL locks permanently once it reaches $100 above the starting balance. From that point, it does not trail further.

 

How the Soft Daily Loss Limit Works

The Soft DLL ($600 on the Builder 25K) is a soft pause, not a breach. If your intraday losses reach the Soft DLL, trading stops for the remainder of that trading session. Your account remains active, and you resume the next trading session as normal.

 

It applies during both the Evaluation and Sim Funded stages. The only rule that can close your account is breaching the MLL.

 

 

News Trading

News trading is fully unrestricted during the evaluation and sim funded stage. You may open and hold positions through any scheduled news event without limitation.

 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

 

Q: Are there any activation fees?

No. There are no activation fees on the Builder Plan.

 

Q: Is there a Daily Loss Limit (DLL)?

Yes. There is a $600 Soft Daily Loss Limit which restricts trading for the remainder of the trading session. You may resume trading once the market reopens. 

 

Q: Is there a consistency rule during evaluation?

No. The Builder Plan has no consistency rule during evaluation. You can pass in as little as 1 trading day, as long as you have hit the $1,500 profit target without breaching the MLL.

 

Q: How does the 50% consistency rule work on payouts?

Your single largest profit day in a payout cycle cannot account for more than 50% of your total profits in that cycle. This is calculated at the time of your payout request, and the calculation resets fully after each approved payout.

 

Example: If your total net profits since the last payout are $1,000, your best single day cannot exceed $500. If it does, you will need to trade additional days to bring that ratio into compliance before requesting.

 

Q: How much net profit do I need before my first payout?

You need at least $250 in net profit above the buffer. For example, on the $2,000 option, your account balance must reach at least $2,600 before you can submit your first payout request ($2,100 buffer plus $500 net profit above it).

 

Q: Can I have more than one active Sim Funded account?

Yes. Traders may have up to 2 Sim Funded accounts, per user, at any time on the Builder 25k Plan. If your active Sim Funded account closes, a new one may be activated only after the following trading day.

 

Q: Can I trade news on the Builder Plan?

News trading is fully unrestricted on the Builder Plan.

 

Q: What happens if my live account is breached?

A live account breach triggers a 21-day cooldown period. During the cooldown, all sim funded account trading is prohibited and no new evaluations or account resets may be purchased. Once the 21 days have elapsed, all restrictions are lifted.

 

Q: Can I hold positions overnight?

No. All positions must be closed before the end of the trading session. Any open positions at session close will be automatically closed by the platform.

 

Q: What is the inactivity rule on the sim funded account?

If you do not place a trade within 7 consecutive calendar days on your sim funded account, the account will be closed due to inactivity. There is no inactivity rule on the live account.

Allowing hedging undermines the integrity of consistent trading and account evaluation. When traders hedge, they can offset losses in one position with gains in another, masking their true risk management and trading skills. This practice can lead to an artificial account stability, making it difficult to assess a trader's actual performance and discipline. Our goal is to evaluate traders based on their ability to manage risk, make informed decisions and maintain profitability without relying on offsetting positions. 
​
It is important to note that hedging through different unrelated assets is permitted. However, when traders rely solely on hedging strategies - even across different assets - it becomes challenging to accurately evaluate their trading abilities. Account Rules
How the EOD Trailing Drawdown Works

The Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) is an End of Day (EOD) trailing drawdown. It does not move intraday. It only adjusts after the market closes each session, based on where your account closed.

The MLL trails upward as your account equity reaches new end-of-day highs.

It never moves down.

Open equity losses are counted when determining whether your account has breached the rule at the end of the trading day.

The MLL locks permanently once it reaches $100 above the starting balance. From that point, it does not trail further.

Frequently Asked Questions

 

Q: Are there any activation fees?

No. There are no activation fees on the Builder Plan.

 

Q: Is there a Daily Loss Limit (DLL)?

No. 

 

Q: Is there a consistency rule during evaluation?

No. The Builder Plan has no consistency rule during evaluation. You can pass in as little as 1 trading day, as long as you have hit the $1,500 profit target without breaching the MLL.

 

Q: How does the 50% consistency rule work on payouts?

Your single largest profit day in a payout cycle cannot account for more than 50% of your total profits in that cycle. This is calculated at the time of your payout request, and the calculation resets fully after each approved payout.

 

Example: If your total net profits since the last payout are $1,000, your best single day cannot exceed $500. If it does, you will need to trade additional days to bring that ratio into compliance before requesting.

 

Q: How much net profit do I need before my first payout?

You need at least $250 in net profit above the buffer. For example, on the $2,000 option, your account balance must reach at least $2,600 before you can submit your first payout request ($2,100 buffer plus $500 net profit above it).

 

Q: Can I have more than one active Sim Funded account?

Yes. Traders may have up to 2 Sim Funded accounts, per user, at any time on the Builder 25k Plan. If your active Sim Funded account closes, a new one may be activated only after the following trading day.

 

Q: Can I trade news on the Builder Plan?

News trading is fully unrestricted on the Builder Plan.

 

Q: What happens if my live account is breached?

A live account breach triggers a 21-day cooldown period. During the cooldown, all sim funded account trading is prohibited and no new evaluations or account resets may be purchased. Once the 21 days have elapsed, all restrictions are lifted.

 

Q: Can I hold positions overnight?

No. All positions must be closed before the end of the trading session. Any open positions at session close will be automatically closed by the platform.

 

Q: What is the inactivity rule on the sim funded account?

If you do not place a trade within 7 consecutive calendar days on your sim funded account, the account will be closed due to inactivity. There is no inactivity rule on the live account.
